claims.text: Lrg burns (> 20% TBSA) require fluid resuscitation
claims.quote: Patients with large burns ( > 20% TBSA) require fluid resuscitation.

claims.text: Parkland formula: (4 mL/kg) × % TBSA burned (partial- and full-thickness) estimates fluid needs for the first 24 hrs after the burn and sets the IV rate
claims.quote: The Parkland formula (4 mL/kg) × % TBSA burned (partial-thickness and full-thickness burns) is used to estimate fluid volume needs in the first 24 hours after the burn (not after presentation to the hospital) and determines the rate of IV fluid administration.

claims.text: Poss smoke inhalation = treated w 100% O2
claims.quote: An airway is provided, ventilation is supported, and possible associated smoke inhalation is treated with 100% oxygen.
